svg.aria-label: Pattern map for Virtual Patient Clinic: each container is outlined, and the backend runs from controllers down through the service layer to a band of engines that are plain Python — including the model router, which only picks a provider — and then to a band of adapters: the DAOs, the speech client, the avatar client and the model providers. That lower band is the only code that reaches another container or a hosted API, and each design pattern is pinned to the part of the code where it lives
svg.text: engines: plain Python — no web, no SQL
adapters: the only code that reaches outside the backend
the avatar client speaks one API to both: localsimli for the local-* avatars, Simli's hosted API for the rest
